data.name: Pocket Bakery
data.shortDescription: Run a tiny bakery out of a single pocket-sized shop. Mix dough, bake bread and decorate cakes for the neighbors before the oven goes cold.

cardImage.alt: A cozy bakery with a smiling baker behind the counter, fresh bread, pastries, cakes, a brick oven and customers enjoying the shop

data.name: Moon Piano
data.shortDescription: A dreamy piano you play under the night sky. Tap the keys to make soft melodies and watch the moon respond to every note.

cardImage.alt: A glowing grand piano in a moonlit landscape, with a large full moon, floating rings, distant mountains and a starry blue sky

data.name: Beehive Valley
data.shortDescription: Look after a valley full of bees. Place hives, plant flowers that bloom in different seasons and collect honey without annoying anyone, including the bees.

cardImage.alt: A beekeeper tending wooden hives in a flower-filled meadow, with rolling green hills, wildflowers, honey jars and a peaceful countryside landscape

data.name: The Last Lighthouse
data.shortDescription: You are the new keeper of a lonely lighthouse. Fix the lamp, answer strange radio messages and guess what the sea wants from you.

cardImage.alt: A lone lighthouse keeper walks along a rocky shoreline toward a glowing lighthouse in a dark, stormy sea

data.name: Tiny Train Depot
data.shortDescription: Build and run a small train depot. Lay tracks, schedule little trains and keep the passengers from missing their connections.

cardImage.alt: A miniature railway station with branching tracks, a steam locomotive, waiting passengers, station buildings and train management controls

data.name: Sleepy Fishing Pond
data.shortDescription: A very chill fishing game. Cast the line, wait, reel in whatever bites and fill the pond journal. Nothing gets away, nothing is rushed.

cardImage.alt: A peaceful fishing scene with a person sitting on a wooden dock over a misty pond at sunrise, holding a fishing rod among reeds and calm water

data.name: Paper Boats
data.shortDescription: Fold little paper boats and send them down a rainy street. Steer them around puddles, leaves and curious ducks.

cardImage.alt: Colorful origami boats floating in rainwater among autumn leaves, with small yellow ducks in the background

data.name: Sock Sorter
data.shortDescription: Find the matching socks in a giant laundry pile. Sort by pattern, color and mood before the washing machine finishes.

cardImage.alt: A cartoon grey animal sits atop a colorful pile of mismatched socks beside a washing machine, with a matching-pairs counter and countdown timer

data.name: Little Orchard
data.shortDescription: Grow a small orchard one tree at a time. Prune, graft and pick fruit, then sell it at the Sunday market or turn it into jam.

cardImage.alt: A gardener picking apples from a small tree in a peaceful orchard, with baskets of fruit, a rustic workbench and jars of preserves

data.name: Mushroom Road
data.shortDescription: A tiny road trip adventure through a mushroom forest. Hitch rides with weird travelers, collect stories and try to reach the festival on time.

cardImage.alt: A whimsical forest path winding through an enchanted woodland filled with giant mushrooms, mushroom houses, glowing plants and a tiny snail traveler
